issues: 1px（设计坐标）描边放大后成片约 4px，空心字读作粗笨的气球边而不是制图细线
3.2× → 1 的收缩只用 10f，速度极大却全程锐利，冲击感打折
瞄准环只是一圈虚线，点亮那一下除了字本身没有任何"锁定"反馈
#030303 纯黑平铺，微尘是方形像素点
changes: 描边收到 0.6px（成片约 2.4px），预热 86→145 的灰度节拍不变；空心字固定用静态字体 Helvetica Neue，避开 SF 可变字体内部重叠轮廓被描出来的问题
急缩段按 scale 中心差分速度给瞬时失焦（≤0.8 设计 px，停稳归零）
虚线圆加四个随圆自转的套准刻度；点亮帧圆与左右水平线同步增亮"锁定"，与字辉光共用同一条 flash 曲线回落
底换带冷色相的近黑径向 + 暗角 + soft-light 颗粒，微尘改圆形柔点、尺寸缩小
10f 收缩、45f 圆收缩、0.6 帧瞬时填充等所有时间窗保持不变
issuesEn: A 1px (design-unit) stroke became ~4px on screen, so the outline word read as a chunky balloon edge rather than a drafting line
The 3.2× → 1 shrink takes only 10f — a huge velocity rendered perfectly sharp, which blunted the impact
The targeting ring was just a dashed circle; at the fill moment nothing but the word itself acknowledged the lock-on
Flat #030303 black, and the dust motes were square pixels
changesEn: Stroke reduced to 0.6px (~2.4px on screen) with the 86→145 pre-brighten beat kept; the outline word is pinned to the static Helvetica Neue because SF's variable outlines expose overlapping inner contours under text-stroke
Transient defocus during the shrink from the central-difference scale velocity (≤0.8 design px, zero at rest)
Four registration ticks rotate with the dashed ring; on the fill frame the ring and both horizontal dashes brighten as a lock-on and fall back on the same flash curve as the word's glow
Ground is a cool-tinted near-black radial with vignette and soft-light grain; dust motes are now small soft round points
Every timing window — 10f shrink, 45f ring shrink, 0.6-frame instant fill — is unchanged
